metadata.source: MediaWiki "Gilder Lehrman Prize for Military History" section of "New York Historical book prizes"
metadata.notes: Established in 2013 as the Guggenheim-Lehrman Prize in Military History and renamed the Gilder Lehrman Prize for Military History at the New-York Historical Society in 2016. Official Gilder Lehrman pages return HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so the cited Wikipedia section is used as a secondary source. Year labels denote the award cycle and are recorded as printed; each cycle is announced the following year. Finalist slates appear only in Gilder Lehrman press releases, which block automated fetching, so finalists are not covered. Official awards URL: https://www.gilderlehrman.org/book-prizes/military-history
